invariants.text: Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.name must be a string
Product.name must not be null
Product.price must be a number
Product.price must not be null
Sale.sale_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.product_id must be an integer
Sale.product_id must not be null
Sale.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
Sale.quantity must be an integer
Sale.quantity must not be null
Sale.sale_date must be a datetime
Sale.sale_date must not be null
The total sales amount for a product is calculated by multiplying the product's price by the sum of the quantities sold in all sales records for that product.
The number of sales per product is the count of sale records associated with each product's product_id.
A sale record must reference a product that exists in the Product table via the product_id field.
The sale_date field in the Sale table must not be null and must represent a valid date.
The quantity field in the Sale table must be greater than zero.
The price field in the Product table must be greater than zero.
The product_id in the Sale table must uniquely identify a product in the Product table.
The total sales amount reported must aggregate across all sales records for each product.
The number of sales per product must be computed by counting distinct sale records per product_id.
A product must have a unique name across all products in the database.
